name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A local-first Codex workflow with one plain-language repository choice, isolated worktrees by default, and safe local integration.

interface.shortDescription: One simple repository choice, then safe isolated AI development by default.
interface.longDescription: Ask once whether to isolate each task, use this directory for one task, or remember normal current-directory development. Isolated work uses exact-path commits, approval-bound validation, FIFO local integration, and safe deinitialization.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use develop-with-worktrees for this modifying Git task. Respect an existing mature workflow; otherwise, on the first intended write ask the single plain-language repository choice before making changes.
